blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video face swapping transfers the reference identity to a target video while preserving its other attributes and motion. Despite recent progress in reference-guided flow-based methods, jointly achieving faithful identity transfer, high fidelity, and real-time generation over long video streams remains challenging. To address this challenge, we rethink the task-specific structure of reference-guided video face swapping. First, face swapping changes only identity while preserving most visual content, yet flow-matching supervision is weakly sensitive to these changes. We therefore develop Joint Rec-ID Loss, which balances explicit identity supervision and latent reconstruction according to the noise level. Second, the target video already provides non-edited attributes and temporal dynamics, enabling generation with fewer spatial tokens and shorter temporal contexts through Face-RoI Generation and Short-Context Rollout Training. By integrating these designs, we propose StreamingSwap, a reference-guided flow-matching framework for real-time streaming video face swapping. We also introduce HumanFaceVid, comprising 1,000 hours of cinematic training data and evaluation sets of 200 short and 200 long videos. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves competitive identity transfer and visual quality at 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with stable generation over videos up to 10 minutes long. Project webpage: https://aim-uofa.github.io/StreamingSwap/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video face swapping transfers identity from a source image to a target video while preserving other target attributes, such as expression, pose, gaze, illumination, and background.
It has broad applications in film production, AI-generated dramas, and live streaming.
GAN-based approaches ( Chen et al., 2020 ; Shiohara et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; Henry, 2025 ) offer strong identity transfer and efficient inference, but processing frames independently can introduce visual artifacts and temporal flicker.
To improve realism and temporal coherence, diffusion-based approaches leverage the generative priors of pretrained video diffusion models.
Among these, inpainting-based approaches ( Han et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) mask the target face and reconstruct it conditioned on source identity and auxiliary attributes, but removing direct access to fine-grained target cues makes non-edited attributes difficult to preserve faithfully.
blocks.zh:
视频面相转换将身份从源图像转移到目标视频,同时保留其他目标属性,如表达,姿势,凝视,发光,和背景等.
它在电影制作,AI出品的剧情,和活生生地流传中都有广泛的应用.
基于GAN的方法(Chen等人,2020年;Shiohara等人,2023年;Luo等人,2025年;Henry,2025年)提供了强大的身份传递和高效的推论,但独立处理框架可以引入视觉文物和时间闪烁.
为提高现实性和时间一致性,基于传播的方法利用了预先训练的视频传播模型的遗传学前科。
其中以涂入为主的方法(Han等,2024;Wang等,2025;Chen等,2024;Shao等,2024)掩盖了被涂入的目标面并重塑其以来源身份和辅助属性为条件,但去除直接取入被涂入的精细目标指使非编辑属性难以忠实地保存.

blocks.en:
Recent reference-guided methods, represented by LivingSwap ( Luo et al., 2026 ) and DreamID-V ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , construct paired supervision to retain the complete target video as a visual reference, enabling more faithful preservation of fine-grained target attributes.
However, the unmasked target face contains not only the attributes to be preserved but also the identity to be replaced, creating a competing identity signal that makes source-identity injection difficult.
Meanwhile, these methods are fine-tuned from large-scale video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and remain computationally expensive due to iterative full-frame denoising over long temporal contexts.
Consequently, extending their high-fidelity results to real-time, long-duration generation while ensuring faithful source-identity transfer remains difficult.
blocks.zh:
最近以LivingSwap(Luo等,2026年)和DreamID-V(Guo等,2026年)为代表的参考制导方法构建了配对监督,以保留完整的目标视频作为视觉参考,使得更忠实地保存了被精细刻画的目标属性.
然而,未蒙面的目标面不仅包含了被保存的属性,还包含了被替换的身份,形成了相竞的身份信号,使得源身份注射变得困难.
同时,这些方法从大型视频传播模型(Wan等,2025年)中进行了微调,由于长时间的迭接式全帧去化,计算成本仍然很高.
因此,在确保忠实的源身份转移的同时,将高纯度结果推广到实时、长期生成仍然很困难。

blocks.en:
These challenges motivate us to rethink reference-guided video face swapping through its task-specific structure.
First, video face swapping changes only identity while preserving most visual content in the target video.
This leaves flow-matching supervision with a weak signal for identity transfer, as identity differences account for only a small fraction of the latent reconstruction error.
Second, the target video directly provides the non-edited attributes and temporal dynamics to be preserved.
Yet existing reference-guided methods still process background over long temporal contexts, resulting in substantial computational redundancy.
blocks.zh:
这些挑战促使我们重新思考以参考为指南的视频通过特定任务结构进行互换。
首先,视频面相交换只改变身份,同时保留目标视频中的大部分视觉内容.
这使得流相匹配的监管对身份转移信号薄弱,因为身份差异只占潜在重建出错的一小部分.
第二,目标视频直接提供需要保存的非编辑属性和时间动态.
然而,现有的参照制方法在较长的时间范围内仍然处理背景,导致大量的计算冗余。

blocks.en:
Guided by these observations, we introduce StreamingSwap , the first reference-guided flow-matching framework for real-time, long-duration video face swapping.
To strengthen source-identity transfer, Joint Rec-ID Loss combines clean-latent reconstruction with explicit identity supervision, balancing their relative contributions according to the noise level.
For efficient generation, Face-RoI Generation restricts video conditioning and generation to face-region tokens, avoiding redundant background computation.
To enable streaming, Short-Context Rollout Training trains the bidirectional model through autoregressive rollout with a short generated history, reducing the mismatch between training and inference while retaining bidirectional generation within each window.
We further introduce HumanFaceVid , a cinematic video face-swapping dataset constructed from OpenHumanVid ( Li et al., 2025 ) , comprising 1,000 hours of training data and evaluation sets of 200 short and 200 long videos.
Across diverse scenarios, StreamingSwap improves identity similarity while preserving target attributes and maintaining high video quality.
It processes videos at 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA 4090 GPU and maintains stable generation for videos up to 10 minutes.

blocks.en: 3 Task-Specific Analysis
blocks.zh: 3 特定任务分析

blocks.en:
The difficulty of combining faithful identity transfer, high visual quality, and real-time long-video generation motivates us to revisit video face swapping through its task-specific structure.
Compared with general-purpose video editing, reference-guided face swapping has two distinctive properties.
blocks.zh:
难以结合忠实身份传递,高视觉质量,以及实时长视频生成,促使我们通过任务特定结构重新审视视频面相交换.
相较于通用视频编辑,参考指针相换相有两种独特的特性.

blocks.en:
First, face swapping has a restricted editing scope: only facial identity should change, while all other facial attributes and content outside the face region should remain consistent with the target video.
However, the flow matching objective optimizes a reconstruction loss over the latent representation of the entire image, which may be insufficiently sensitive to identity changes when most visual content remains unchanged.
To quantify this potential mismatch, we investigate how strongly the flow-matching objective penalizes identity-transfer failures (Q1) .
blocks.zh:
首先,面相交换有限制的编辑范围:只有面相身份应该改变,而面相区域外的所有其他面相属性和内容都应该与目标视频保持一致.
然而,流量匹配目标将重建损失优化于整个图像的潜在表现,当大多数视觉内容保持不变时,整个图像可能对身份变化不够敏感.
为了量化这种潜在的不匹配,我们调查流量匹配目标对身份转让失败(问题1)的处罚程度。

blocks.en:
Second, the desired output is densely specified by visual inputs: the source image provides the identity, while the target video supplies not only non-identity facial attributes within the edited region but also the surrounding content and temporal dynamics.
Nevertheless, existing reference-guided methods generate full frames, including regions that require no editing, and attend over extended temporal contexts to maintain consistency.
To examine this potential computational redundancy, we investigate how much spatial and temporal context is actually required to preserve fidelity (Q2) .
blocks.zh:
其次,所希望的输出由视觉输入来密集地指定:源图像提供身份,而目标视频不仅提供被编辑区域内的非身份面部属性,还提供周边内容和时间动态.
尽管如此,现有的参考指导方法产生完整的框架,包括不需要编辑的区域,并涵盖较长的时间范围,以保持一致性。
为了审查这种潜在的计算冗余性,我们调查为了保持忠诚(问题2),实际需要多少空间和时间背景。

blocks.en: We investigate these questions through two controlled analysis experiments.

Training should directly supervise source identity to complement the weak sensitivity of latent reconstruction to identity changes. • Focused spatial and temporal computation. Generation should exploit the target-provided content and motion to concentrate computation on face-region tokens and a short temporal context.

Training with ground-truth history creates a mismatch with streaming inference, where prediction errors can propagate through the generated history and accumulate across chunks.
Inspired by Self Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , we fine-tune the Phase-I model through autoregressive self-rollout, exposing it to its own generated history during training (Fig. 3 , right).
We use a 4-step denoising schedule, as the Phase-I model achieves comparable identity and target-attribute performance with 4 and 25 steps at substantially higher throughput (App. E ).
Following the stochastic gradient-truncation strategy of Self Forcing, we randomly select a denoising step as the stopping point and backpropagate only through the clean-latent prediction at that step.
Gradients are stopped through both the generated history and preceding denoising steps.
Rather than a distribution-matching objective, we use the Phase-I identity and Face-RoI reconstruction losses in Eq. 13 to supervise the newly generated frames, retaining the noise-dependent weights in Eq. 14 .

blocks.en: 5.1 Comparisons with Existing Methods

blocks.en:
We compare StreamingSwap with two representative GAN-based methods and four diffusion-based methods that can run on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with quantitative and qualitative results in Table 1 and Fig. 4 .
Long-video comparisons include three strong-performing methods.
Across both benchmarks, StreamingSwap achieves effective identity transfer while preserving target fidelity and visual realism.
Although InSwapper and DreamID-V achieve higher identity similarity, the frame-level scores in Fig. 4 illustrate that higher embedding similarity does not necessarily imply better perceptual quality or target fidelity.
DreamID-V exhibits pronounced changes in lighting and head pose despite high ID Sim. scores, while InSwapper’s high scores coexist with less realism in the displayed examples.
In contrast, StreamingSwap maintains recognizable source identity while more closely following the target lighting, expressions, and head poses.
These comparisons highlight the importance of balancing identity similarity and target-attribute reconstruction, as further examined in App. F .
Overall, StreamingSwap offers a balanced quality–efficiency, exceeding 20 FPS and achieving substantially higher throughput than the evaluated diffusion baselines.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented StreamingSwap , a reference-guided framework for streaming video face swapping that aligns supervision and computation with the task requirements.
Our analysis motivates Joint Rec-ID Loss to strengthen identity transfer, alongside Face-RoI Generation and Short-Context Rollout Training to reduce spatial and temporal computation.
We also introduced HumanFaceVid to support training and evaluation on short and long videos.
Experiments demonstrate competitive identity transfer and target fidelity at over 20 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, with stable generation on videos up to 10 minutes long.
These results show that task-specific supervision and compact context can make reference-guided generation substantially more efficient.

我们介绍了StreamingSwap,这是一个用于进行视频相换的参考指导框架,使监督和计算符合任务要求。
我们的分析促使联合Rec-ID损失加强身份转让,同时进行Face-RoI生成和短文本推出培训,以减少空间和时间计算。
我们还引进了HumanFaceVid,以支持短视频和长视频的培训和评价。
实验在单NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU上显示20多位FPS的竞争性身份转移和目标忠诚,视频上的稳定生成可长达10分钟.
这些结果显示,针对具体任务的监督和紧凑环境可以大大提高参考指南生成的效率。

This work develops video face-swapping techniques for research and creative applications, including film production, AI-generated dramas, and live streaming.

We oppose deceptive and non-consensual uses of this technology and advocate obtaining appropriate permissions and consent, respecting privacy and content ownership, and clearly labeling manipulated media.

blocks.en:
Video face swapping transfers the identity of a source face to a target video while preserving target-specific attributes such as expression, pose, illumination, motion, and background.
Existing approaches can be broadly grouped into GAN-based methods, which emphasize efficient feed-forward synthesis, and diffusion-based methods, which leverage generative priors to improve visual quality and temporal coherence.

现有方法可以大致分为基于全球网络的方法,这些方法强调高效的饲料向前合成,以及基于传播的方法,这些方法利用基因前科提高视觉质量和时间一致性。

blocks.en: A.1 GAN-based video face swapping
blocks.zh: A.1 基于 GAN 的视频相换

blocks.en:
GAN-based face swapping learns efficient feed-forward generators under adversarial supervision ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) .
Early systems used shared encoders with identity-specific decoders and therefore required separate training for each identity pair ( DeepFakes, 2020 ) .
Later subject-agnostic methods inject source-identity features into target representations and improve identity transfer or identity-attribute disentanglement through specialized architectures, objectives, and identity encoders ( Li et al., 2019 ; Gao et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2020 ; Shiohara et al., 2023 ) .
CanonSwap extends this direction to videos by modifying identity in a canonical space before restoring target motion ( Luo et al., 2025 ) .
InSwapper is a widely used one-shot model distributed through the InsightFace ecosystem, although its architecture and training procedure are not publicly documented Henry (2025) .
While these methods offer efficient inference, most image-based variants process videos frame by frame and thus do not explicitly model temporal dependencies.
blocks.zh:
基于GAN的相换相机在对抗性监督下学习了高效的向馈发电机(Goodfellow等人,2014年)。
早期系统使用共享编码器,并配有特定身份解码器,因此需要对每对身份进行单独培训(Deep Fakes,2020.).
后来的主题-不可知论方法将源识别特征注入到目标表达中,并通过专门的架构,目标和身份编码器来改进身份转移或身份分配分解(Li等,2019;Gao等,2021;Chen等,2020;Shiohara等,2023).
CanonSwap将这个方向延伸至视频,在恢复目标运动之前,在犬科空间修改身份(Luo等,2025年).
InSwapper是一个被广泛使用的一发模式,通过InsightFace生态系统来分发,尽管其架构和培训程序没有公开记载Henry (2025).
虽然这些方法提供了高效的推论,但大多数基于图像的变体都按帧处理视频帧,因此没有明确模拟时间依赖性.

blocks.en: A.2 Diffusion-based video face swapping
blocks.zh: A.2 传播视频相换

blocks.en:
The rapid development and application of diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) have enabled a second line of face-swapping methods with stronger generative priors.
One branch follows an inpainting-oriented formulation, in which the target face is masked or otherwise reconstructed from the source identity and explicit target-attribute conditions.
DiffSwap formulates face swapping as conditional inpainting and combines masked diffusion with identity and 3D facial guidance ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) .
Face-Adapter introduces lightweight modules for injecting source identity, spatial structure, and detailed target attributes into pretrained image diffusion models ( Han et al., 2024 ) .
Extending this formulation to videos, DynamicFace decomposes facial conditions using 3D priors and incorporates temporal modeling, while HiFiVFS builds on a pretrained video diffusion model with disentangled target-attribute extraction and detailed identity injection ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
VividFace jointly trains on images and videos and introduces a video-oriented VAE, identity-attribute disentanglement data, and 3D facial guidance to improve temporal consistency and robustness ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
Related identity-control frameworks instead introduce lightweight conditional branches into pretrained video generators and can be adapted to face swapping, although face swapping is not their primary formulation Xue et al. (2026) .
These approaches improve synthesis quality and temporal modeling, but reconstructing a removed target face from auxiliary conditions can discard fine-grained appearance cues that are difficult to recover explicitly.
blocks.zh:
扩散模型的迅速发展和应用(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年;Zhu等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2026年)使得有更强基因前传的第二行相扑方法成为可能.
一个分支遵循了以涂入为导向的配体,在配体中,目标面部被遮住或以其他方式从源身份和明确的目标属性条件中重建出.
DiffSwap会将面相交换作为有条件的涂料并结合了口罩扩散与身份和3D面部指导(赵等,2023).
Face-Adapter将用于注射源身份、空间结构以及详细目标属性的轻量级模块引入了预先训练的图像传播模型(Han等,2024年)。
将这种配方扩展至视频,DynamicFace用3D前作分解面部条件并纳入时间模型,而HiFiVFS则以经过预先训练的视频传播模型为基础,分解出目标属性提取和详细的身份注射(Wang等,2025;Chen等,2024).
VividFace在图像和视频上联合出轨,并引入了面向视频的VAE,身份分配分解数据,以及3D面部指导,以提高时间一致性和稳健性(Shao等,2024年).
相关的身份控制框架反而将轻量级有条件的分机引入了预先训练的视频生成器,并可以被改造为面相互换,尽管面相互换并不是其主要配方薛等 (2026).
这些方法提高了合成质量和时间建模,但从辅助条件中重建被移除的目标面可丢弃难以明确恢复的精细外观提示.

blocks.en:
A more recent reference-guided branch retains the complete target video as a visual condition and learns face swapping from synthetically constructed pairs.
LivingSwap reverses GAN-generated training pairs so that real videos provide reconstruction targets, and uses edited keyframes together with temporal stitching to maintain identity across video chunks ( Luo et al., 2026 ) .
DreamID-V constructs bidirectional identity supervision through SyncID-Pipe and trains a Diffusion Transformer with modality-aware conditioning, curriculum learning, and identity-coherence optimization ( Guo et al., 2026 ) .
By directly observing the target face, reference-guided models can preserve fine-grained expressions, illumination, makeup, and occlusions more faithfully.
However, access to the complete target face also allows the model to reconstruct most of the video while responding weakly to the source identity, and existing systems retain the computational cost of full-frame, chunk-based diffusion generation.
Our work follows the reference-guided formulation but studies a different boundary: identity-sensitive supervision and efficient streaming inference using face-region generation and a fixed-size generated history.
blocks.zh:
更近的参考制导分支保留了完整的目标视频作为可视条件,从合成成对中学习面相交换.
LivingSwap将GAN生成的训练配对倒置,让真实的视频提供重建目标,并使用被编辑的键框与时间缝合来保持跨视频块的身份(Luo等,2026年).
DreamID-V通过SyncID-Pipe构建双向身份监督,并培训一台具有模式意识的变形器,课程学习,以及身份协调优化(Guo等,2026年).
通过直接观察目标面部,参考指针模型可以更忠实地保存精细的纹理表达,发光,化妆和被隔离.
然而,访问完整的目标面也使得模型可以重建大部分视频,同时对源身份反应薄弱,而现有的系统保留了全帧,块基传播生成的计算成本.
我们的工作遵循以参考为指南的提法,但研究了不同的界限:对身份敏感的监督和利用相貌区域生成和固定规模创造历史的有效流出推论。

blocks.en:
Movie footage requires identity editing to preserve both cinematic lighting and the nuances of the original performance.
The displayed results follow the target video’s illumination, subtle facial expressions, and head poses, including shots with partial occlusion, integrating the source identity while retaining the scene’s visual character.

电影片段需要身份编辑,既能保留影视照明,又能保留原作表演的细微差别.

blocks.en:
Live and online videos require sustained streaming generation that follows a speaker’s expressions and head movements.
Our method supports continuous processing with stable facial appearance in the displayed sequences, including partially occluded faces.
Its streaming throughput makes it suitable for live-video applications whose frame-rate and buffering requirements match the measured processing speed and latency.
blocks.zh:
现场直播和网络视频需要持续流传的一代,
我们的方法支持持续处理,在所显示的序列中保持稳定的面部外观,包括部分被占用的面相.
其流流吞吐量使其适合活视频应用,其帧率和缓冲性要求与所测量的处理速度和耐用性相匹配.

blocks.en:
AI-generated short dramas present another use case: reinforcing character identity when large motions, complex lighting, or exaggerated expressions cause identity drift.
By applying a consistent source identity to the generated footage, StreamingSwap provides an efficient post-processing step that strengthens identity consistency while retaining the original performance and scene context, without regenerating the entire scene.
blocks.zh:
AI所生成的短剧呈现出另一个用法: 当大型运动,复杂照明,或夸张的表达导致身份漂移时,强化人物身份.
StreamingSwap通过对所生成的镜头应用一致的源身份,提供了高效的后处理步骤,既能加强身份一致性,又能保留原有的性能和场景上下文,而不会使整个场景再生.

blocks.en:
Metrics. We evaluate identity transfer, target-attribute preservation, video quality, and inference efficiency.
Following DreamID-V ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , we measure identity transfer using cosine similarity between ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2019a ) embeddings of the source image and generated frames, reported as ID Sim.
We also annotate the displayed outputs with frame-level ID Sim. scores to facilitate comparison between embedding similarity and visual appearance.
Following LivingSwap ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , we assess target-attribute preservation through distances between generated and corresponding target frames in estimated head pose (Pose) ( Ruiz et al., 2018 ) , expression coefficients (Expr.) ( Deng et al., 2019b ) , and lighting coefficients (Light) ( Deng et al., 2019b ) .
Gaze preservation is measured by cosine similarity between their estimated 3D gaze vectors (Gaze) ( Abdelrahman et al., 2023 ) .
We evaluate video quality using Fréchet Video Distance (FVD).
For efficiency, FPS measures the number of newly generated video frames output per second by the complete pipeline, excluding reused history frames.
Latency measures the end-to-end time required for a single inference run.
Both measurements include VAE encoding, denoising, VAE decoding, and output compositing.

blocks.en:
Implementation Details. We initialize our model from the pretrained DreamID-V checkpoint ( Guo et al., 2026 ) and train Phase I and Phase II for 1,000 iterations each.
Both phases use a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} and a batch size of 8.
In Phase II, each training rollout consists of five autoregressive generation windows.
Training uses four NVIDIA H100 GPUs, while all inference-speed measurements are conducted on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU.
For inference acceleration, we use SageAttention ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) for DiT self-attention and cross-attention, and compile Transformer blocks individually using torch.compile .
We also replace the native Wan VAE with LightTAE for Wan 2.1 ( ModelTC, ) for lightweight encoding and decoding.
For fair efficiency comparisons, we apply the same acceleration strategies to all compatible methods.

blocks.en:
Setup. We compare the DreamID-V initialization with 16 denoising steps, the Phase-I bidirectional model with 25 and 4 steps, and the final Phase-II streaming model with 4 steps.
We evaluate identity similarity, target-attribute preservation, and end-to-end throughput to assess the effects of training phase and sampling budget.
To contextualize the sampling results, we also track identity and attribute metrics along the denoising trajectories of DreamID-V and the Phase-I model.
blocks.zh:
设相. 我们比较了DreamID-V初始化与16个去诺化步骤,Phase-I双向模型有25个和4个步骤,最后的Phase-II流化模型有4个步骤.
我们评价身份相似性、目标属性保全和端到端的吞吐量,以评估培训阶段和抽样预算的影响。
为了将取样结果的背景化,我们还沿着DreamID-V和第一阶段模型的去诺化轨迹追踪身份和属性度量。

blocks.en:
Results and interpretation. As shown in Table 3 , the four-step Phase-I model improves identity similarity from 0.445 0.445 to 0.583 0.583 over the initialization and improves all four target-attribute metrics.
Compared with 25-step sampling, it achieves comparable or slightly better identity, pose, expression, and lighting scores, together with higher gaze similarity, while increasing throughput from 6.702 6.702 to 30.280 30.280 FPS, a 4.52 × 4.52\times speedup.
The final streaming model retains most of this identity similarity ( 0.577 0.577 ) and further improves pose, lighting, and gaze scores, with a slight increase in expression error.
Its throughput decreases to 21.174 21.174 FPS because streaming repeatedly processes overlapping history and incurs per-window overhead, while reused history frames are excluded from the output frame count.
These results support four-step sampling as an efficient choice for rollout training and streaming inference.
blocks.zh:
果与释. 如表3所示,四相相相一模型在初始化后将特性相似度从0.445 0.445提高到0.583 0583,并改善了所有四个目标属性度量。
相较于25步取样,它实现了可比较或略好的身份,姿势,表达和照明分数,同时更高的视差相似度,同时将吞吐量从6.702 6.702提高到30.280 30.280 FPS, a 4.52× 4.52\时速加速.
最终的流线模型保留了这种身份的大部分相似性(0.577 0.577)并进一步提高了姿势,照明和凝视分数,表现错误略有增加.
吞吐量减少到21.174 21.174 FPS因为流相反复地处理相重叠的历史,并产生每个窗口的间接费用,而再利用的历史帧则被排除在输出帧计数之外.
这些结果支持分四步进行取样,作为展开培训和流出推论的有效选择。

blocks.en:
The trajectories in Fig. 10 provide further context for the sampling results.
For our model, identity similarity improves through most of denoising before declining slightly near the endpoint, whereas expression and lighting errors generally increase after reaching their minima early in the trajectory.
Thus, progressing further along the denoising trajectory does not consistently improve the evaluated metrics.
One possible explanation is that late-stage refinement introduces appearance details that do not necessarily improve identity or attribute similarity as measured by the evaluation encoders.
This interpretation is consistent with the slightly better scores obtained with four-step sampling, although the trajectories alone do not establish why changing the step count produces these gains.
Four-step sampling may still sacrifice some fine visual detail relative to 25 steps, so its favorable identity and attribute scores should not be interpreted as uniformly better perceptual quality.
blocks.zh:
图10中的轨迹为取样结果提供了进一步的背景。
对我们的模型来说,身份相似性通过在接近终点时稍有下降之前的多数发号施令而得到改善,而表达和照明错误在轨迹早期达到最小值后一般会增加。
因此,在取消提名的轨迹方面取得进一步进展,并不能持续地改进所评价的衡量标准。
一种可能的解释是后期的改进引入了外观细节,这些细节不一定能改善评价编码器所测量的特征或属性相似性.
这种解释与通过四步抽样获得的略好一些的分数是一致的,尽管仅靠轨迹并不能确定改变步数产生这些收益的原因.
四步采样相对于25步仍然可能牺牲出一些细微的视觉细节,因此其有利的身份和属性分数不应被解释为统一更好的感知质量.

We examine how the weighting schedule, switching threshold, and reconstruction objective affect the balance between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation.

blocks.en:
Setup. We compare seven piecewise-constant weighting configurations, L1–L7, with the noise range divided at σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 (Fig. 11 (a)).
The identity weight is either 0.1 0.1 or 0 0 , and the reconstruction weight is either 10 10 or 0.1 0.1 .
For L2, we further vary the switching threshold τ \tau over { 0.3 , 0.4 , 0.5 , 0.6 , 0.7 } \{0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6,0.7\} , keeping the identity weight at 0.1 0.1 and the high- and low-noise reconstruction weights at 10 10 and 0.1 0.1 , respectively.
We also compare clean-endpoint and velocity reconstruction under the L2 schedule and examine the gradient norms of the identity and two reconstruction losses during training.
All configurations share the same initialization, training budget, and four-step evaluation protocol on the short200 benchmark of HumanFaceVid .

所有配置共享相同的初始化,培训预算,以及HumanFaceVid 短200基准上的四步评价协议.

blocks.en:
Weighting configurations. L2 balances identity transfer and target-attribute preservation by retaining identity supervision throughout training while reducing the reconstruction weight at low noise levels.
Compared with L1, it strengthens identity transfer with small changes in attribute preservation and imaging quality.
Removing identity supervision from either noise interval weakens identity transfer (L3/L4/L7), whereas weakening high-noise reconstruction compromises target fidelity despite stronger identity similarity (L5/L6).
The qualitative results in Fig. 12 illustrate this trade-off, particularly the changes in expression and lighting under L5/L6.
Together with its knee-point position in Fig. 11 (b), these results support L2 as a balanced choice.
blocks.zh:
重量配置. L2通过在整个培训中保持身份监督,同时降低低噪音水平的重建重量,平衡身份转移和目标属性保存.
相较于L1,它随着属性保存和成像质量的微小变化而加强了身份传递.
从任何噪音间隔中去除身份监督都会削弱身份转移(L3/L4/L7),而削弱高噪音重建则会损害目标忠诚,尽管身份相似性更强(L5/L6)。
图12的质量结果说明了这种取舍,特别是L5/L6规定的表达和照明的变化。
这些结果连同其在图11(b)中的膝分位置,支持L2作为一种平衡的选择.

blocks.en:
Switching threshold. Increasing τ \tau narrows the noise interval receiving strong reconstruction supervision, favoring identity transfer over target-attribute preservation.
Across the sweep, identity similarity increases alongside expression and lighting errors, while pose and gaze vary non-monotonically.
Under the normalized aggregation in Fig. 11 (c), τ = 0.4 \tau=0.4 achieves the highest attribute score and τ = 0.7 \tau=0.7 the highest identity score.
We use τ = 0.5 \tau=0.5 , the knee point of this trade-off.

在整个扫荡过程中,身份相似性随着表达和照明出错而增加,而姿势和视线则在非模拟上有所不同.
在图11(c)中归一化的汇总下,τ=0.4\tau=0.4实现最高属性分,τ=0.7\tau=0.7实现最高身份分.

blocks.en:
Reconstruction objective. We compare clean-endpoint and velocity reconstruction while keeping the velocity-prediction architecture unchanged.
The training gradient norms in Fig. 13 indicate that endpoint reconstruction maintains a more consistent gradient scale relative to identity supervision across noise levels.
Under the L2 schedule, endpoint reconstruction achieves higher identity similarity, lower expression and lighting errors, and slightly higher gaze similarity, at the cost of higher pose error (Table 13 ).
We therefore adopt endpoint reconstruction for its favorable balance between identity transfer and target-attribute preservation.
blocks.zh:
重建目标。 我们比较干净的终点和速度重建,同时保持速度预测结构不变。
图13中的培训梯度规范表明,端点重建相对于不同噪音层次的身份监督而言,保持了更一致的梯度尺度.
在L2时间表下,端点重建实现更高的身份相似性,较低的表达和照明出错,以及略高的视线相似性,而代价是较高的构成出错(表13.
因此,我们通过最终点重建,以便在身份转让与目标属性保护之间取得有利的平衡。

blocks.en:
Setup. We vary the history length N ctx N_{\mathrm{ctx}} and generation length N gen N_{\mathrm{gen}} to examine the quality–efficiency trade-off in streaming inference.
Following Sec. 4.3 , each continuation generates N gen N_{\mathrm{gen}} new latent frames conditioned on N ctx N_{\mathrm{ctx}} clean composited history frames, using bidirectional attention within the window.
Unlike the main results, which use a model trained with a fixed ( N ctx , N gen ) = ( 3 , 9 ) (N_{\mathrm{ctx}},N_{\mathrm{gen}})=(3,9) configuration, this ablation uses a model trained for 1,000 iterations with randomly sampled window sizes.
Table 5 compares six configurations in terms of identity similarity, target-attribute preservation, and end-to-end throughput and latency.
blocks.zh:
设相. 我们改变历史长度 N ctx N_{\mathrm{ctx} 和生成长度 N gen N_{\mathrm{gen} 来检查流推论中的质量 - 效率权衡。
sec. 4.3之后,每次续作都会生成N gen N_{\-mathrm{gen}}-以Ntx N_{\-mathrm{ctx}}-清洁复合历史框架为条件的新潜在帧,在窗口内使用双向关注.
与主要结果不同的是,使用训练有固定(N ctx,N gen)=(3,9)的模型(N_{\ mathrm{ctx}},N_{\ mathrm{gen}})=(3,9)配置,这种衰减使用训练有1000个迭代的模型,随机抽取出窗口大小.
表5比较了身份相似性,目标属性保存,以及端到端的吞吐量和耐用性等6个配置.

blocks.en:
Results. Increasing N gen N_{\mathrm{gen}} at a fixed history length improves throughput but increases latency, whereas increasing N ctx N_{\mathrm{ctx}} at a fixed generation length adds computational overhead and reduces throughput.
Among the evaluated configurations, ( N ctx , N gen ) = ( 3 , 9 ) (N_{\mathrm{ctx}},N_{\mathrm{gen}})=(3,9) achieves the highest FPS with lower latency than the larger-window alternatives.
Target-attribute preservation generally improves with larger windows, while identity similarity peaks at ( 3 , 3 ) (3,3) and then declines.
We therefore adopt ( 3 , 9 ) (3,9) as a practical balance between throughput and latency, while maintaining competitive identity transfer and target-attribute preservation.
blocks.zh:
结果。 在固定历史长度下增加N gen N_{\ mathrm{ gen}}会提高吞吐量但会增加耐久性,而增加N ctx N_{\ mathrm{ ctx}} 在固定生成长度下增加计算间接费用并减少吞吐量.
在被评价的配置中, (N ctx, N gen) = (3, 9) (N_{\ mathrm{ctx}}, N_{\ mathrm{gen}}) = (3,9) 实现最高的FPS, 与较大的窗口替代品相比,其延迟度更低.

因此,我们采用(3,9)(3,9)作为吞吐量和耐用度之间的实际平衡,同时保持竞争性身份转让和目标属性保存。
